title: Automated Compliance Checker for AI Safety Commitments

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible with gap: shallow NLP keyword checks can surface commitment-document mismatches at scale, but may not catch substantive compliance failures. The gap between keyword presence and actual compliance is significant.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: web scraping and keyword extraction/NLP are well-documented Python tasks. Beginner CS students with medium compute can handle this with standard libraries.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Sustained effort: scraping multiple sources (model cards, safety reports, policy docs), building the NLP pipeline, and validating results across companies requires sustained work within 30 hours.

novelty.reasoning: Multiple commercial and open-source tools already automate AI compliance checking using NLP. FairNow, Credo AI, Norm AI, and Google Checks all perform automated regulatory compliance analysis. The EU AI Act Compliance Checker provides a specific implementation for regulatory verification. While these tools focus on regulatory compliance rather than voluntary safety commitments specifically, the core technical approach (NLP-based keyword and semantic matching against commitment documents) is well-established. The specific niche of checking voluntary safety pledges against public actions is a minor variant of existing compliance automation.
